topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The day started just like any other, but as I opened my front door, there they were—vibrant sunflowers, their golden faces tilted towards the morning light. No card, no note, just a bouquet wrapped in rustic brown paper. I brought them inside, their fragrance filling the air, and found the perfect vase for them. The kitchen looked brighter, the whole house felt warmer. Every glance at those sunflowers brought a lightness to my step, a soft smile playing at the corners of my lips. They were a surprise, a mystery, but oh, such a delightful one! As the day went on, the sunflowers seemed to whisper secrets of joy, reminding me that sometimes the most unexpected gifts can make the day truly special.
